name: City Union Bank Ltd
title: City Union Bank Ltd - 532210 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Bank grew advances about 26% YoY to INR66,698 crore with gross NPA down to 1.91% and CASA at 28%, but management flagged it was pushing growth and margin commentary is guidance-driven, not supply-side.

triggers.label: ROA exit FY27 1.65-1.67%
triggers.quote: we should exit this year with at least 10 bps more in ROA, so we should be there between 1.65% to 1.67%

triggers.label: Advances growth ~26% YoY
triggers.quote: it increased to INR66,698 crores from INR53,066 crores in the same period last year

triggers.label: NIM 3.87% Q4, FY26 3.74%
triggers.quote: For the year ended 31st March 2026, the net interest margin is 3.74 %

guidance.quote: we should be 2% to 3% over and above the credit growth of the industry
we should be there between 1.65% to 1.67%
stable net interest margin for the current financial year '27 with almost in the same narrow band of maybe 5 to 10 basis points
We expect an elevated operating expenses for the current year in the range of 15% to 18% over the last year
Our endeavour on the CDR continues to be 85% to 87% based on the credit growth

prior_guidance_check.quote: we will end up with high teen growth for the financial year 2026, which will be over and above the industry level growth
Our return on assets for the Q4 financial year '26 for the full year is '26 is at 1.56 %
our slippage for the whole year will be about INR700 to INR750 crores

red_flags.label: Gold loan concentration near internal ~30% cap
red_flags.quote: on gold loan, basically, the 30, 31, 32 itself is like say we are almost at the upper band

red_flags.label: Management expects incremental slippage of 1-2% extra in downturn
red_flags.quote: Maybe like that incremental slippage rate of maybe 1% or 2% extra may come because of this economic cycles and all

evasions.quote: this difficult question I have to pass and Vijay Anandh has to answer
it depends upon the regulatory comfort
